summary.headline: Puravankara Q1 FY27 presales rose 28% YoY to INR1,439 crores and PAT turned positive at INR25 crores; FY27 presales guidance of INR11,200 crores reiterated.
summary.overview: Presales grew 28% YoY to INR1,439 crores on 9% higher volume (1.36 million sq ft) and 18% higher realisation (INR10,589/sq ft). Collections rose 40% to INR1,199 crores and 745 homes (0.94 million sq ft) were handed over. Total income rose 63% YoY to INR877 crores, EBITDA margin expanded to 25% from 15%, and PAT was INR25 crores versus a loss of INR69 crores a year earlier. Management kept FY27 presales guidance and the INR700 crores debt-reduction target, while adding four Bengaluru land opportunities (GDV ~INR5,200 crores) and signing a sale of Purva Zentech to ICICI Prudential AMC at ~INR625 crores EV.

financial_highlights.change: vs loss of INR69 crores in Q1 FY26

financial_highlights.value: Reduced by INR74 crores in the quarter

segments.name: South
segments.commentary: Contributed INR1,046 crores of presales in Q1 FY27 per management. Projects cited include Northern Light and Provident Equinox.

segments.name: West & Commercial
segments.commentary: Contributed INR393 crores of presales in Q1 FY27, including ~INR200 crores from Purva Estrella (per Rajat Rastogi's estimate). Aerocity received OC for 1.3 million sq ft; Miami has RERA and is on sale.

qa_highlights.question: Why did land payment reach INR574 crores in cash flow, and what is the outlook for land spend?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the amount paid for the four Bengaluru acquisitions from cash on hand; no land cost is unpaid, but future development spend will be booked as construction cost, and new land purchases would add land payments.

qa_highlights.question: How much debt will come off with the ICICI Prudential AMC Purva Zentech deal, and how will proceeds be used?
qa_highlights.answer: About INR250 crores of debt on that asset will be repaid from proceeds; the rest will be evaluated for debt reduction, business development or working capital, with closing expected this month.

qa_highlights.question: Are the Q2 launches (Westend, Hennur Road, Cityspire, Winworth) on track, and any approval issues?
qa_highlights.answer: Westend has RERA and is launched with good EOIs; Hennur Road delayed by Karnataka government change, clarity expected this week; Cityspire and Winworth only await RERA, expected this quarter.

qa_highlights.question: Is the INR11,200 crores presales guidance and INR700 crores debt reduction still intact?
qa_highlights.answer: Both held; launches slipping from Q1 moved to Q2 for one or two projects, and management said opportunity spend versus debt reduction will be reviewed from time to time.

qa_highlights.question: What margin is targeted over the next two years?
qa_highlights.answer: EBITDA margin guidance of 25-30% at portfolio level held, with product mix (plotted, JDA, outright, redevelopment) causing project-level variation.

qa_highlights.question: How much did Purva Estrella contribute to Q1 sales and how does it compare with the top projects?
qa_highlights.answer: Estrella contributed about INR200 crores in Q1 and about INR800 crores since launch; management could not confirm a separate top-three ranking, citing South's Northern Light and Provident Equinox and West's Estrella.

qa_highlights.question: What is the debt reduction plan over three years?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said there is no zero-debt target; free cash flow will be split between new opportunities and debt, and debt is an important part of the business as the portfolio (about INR58,500 crores) grows.

qa_highlights.question: What is the leasing status and rate expectation for Purva Aerocity, and when is Phase 2?
qa_highlights.answer: OC for 1.3 million sq ft; about 2.5 million sq ft of RFPs filed with no lease signed yet; LOIs expected at INR60-65 per sq ft. Phase 2 (0.9 million sq ft) to start after 70-80% of Phase 1 is leased, possibly in the next few quarters; monetisation possible later.

guidance_outlook: FY27 presales guidance of INR11,200 crores reiterated; management said it holds the number despite Q1 presales of INR1,439 crores, with 1-2 projects slipped from Q1 to Q2.
Project-wise launch guidance totals about INR27,300 crores of launches, plus about INR10,000 crores of sustenance projects; management expects some Q2 launches to slip to Q3 and Q3 to Q4.
Debt reduction target of INR700 crores for FY27 retained; gross debt fell INR74 crores in Q1 despite four new Bengaluru acquisitions.
EBITDA margin guidance of 25% to 30% at portfolio level held; Q1 printed 25%.
About INR250 crores of debt sits on Purva Zentech and will be repaid from the ICICI Prudential AMC proceeds; closing expected in August 2026.

Launch timing: Westend RERA received and launched; Cityspire, Winworth and Winworth 3 awaiting final RERA approval, expected this quarter; Hennur Road delayed by Karnataka government change; Pali Hill launch planned Oct-Nov 2026; Apna Ghar 3 and Deonar Baug in Q4.
capex_capacity: Four Bengaluru acquisitions in Q1 (about 41.93 acres, 4.23 million sq ft development potential, GDV about INR5,200 crores): JDAs at Sarjapur and Doddagubbi, land at Sanna Amanikere and Mandur; land cost fully paid, with INR574 crores land payment in cash flow funded from cash on hand.

Purva Aerocity (commercial, about 2.2 million sq ft): OC received for 1.3 million sq ft; balance 0.9 million sq ft not started, to be built in phases once 70-80% of Phase 1 is leased. RFPs filed for about 2.5 million sq ft.
New commercial project at recently acquired Hebbal land (about 1.3 million sq ft) planned to start construction by end of Q4 FY27.

Pali Hill (Mumbai) to apply for RERA by end-September 2026; launch targeted October-November. Miami RERA received in June and on sale; Apna Ghar 3 and Deonar Baug submitted for approvals, Q4 launch targeted.
Mumbai landscape of about INR25,000 crores GDV across South Bombay, Thane and Dombivli, per Rajat Rastogi; NCR (Noida) being evaluated for first land development.
demand_pricing: Q1 presales INR1,439 crores (+28% YoY): South INR1,046 crores; West & Commercial INR393 crores, including about INR200 crores from Purva Estrella. Estrella cumulative sales about INR800 crores since launch.
Volume 1.36 million sq ft (+9% YoY) and realisation INR10,589 per sq ft (+18% YoY); management says growth was not reliant on one lever.
South demand described as steady with no slowdown; growth expected to be lower than 2024-25 levels, with well-priced, well-designed branded products doing well.
Mumbai and Pune: branded players gaining share; Purva Miami in Breach Candy drew encouraging ultra-luxury response; demand expected to build into festive season.
Aerocity lease rate expected around INR60-65 per sq ft via LOIs; GCC and large-company RFP interest reported.
risks_watch: Launch slippage: Hennur Road delayed by Karnataka government change; several RERA approvals still pending for Q2 launches, and the guidance relies on about INR27,300 crores of project launches.
Presales guidance of INR11,200 crores needs about INR9,761 crores in Q2-Q4 (implied by Q1 INR1,439 crores); requires sustained launch cadence.

Debt: net debt INR2,836 crores, net debt to equity 1.57x, average cost of debt 11.12%; management has not committed to a timeline beyond the INR700 crores FY27 reduction target and says new opportunities may take priority.
Aerocity leasing: no signed leases yet on 2.2 million sq ft asset; Phase 2 timing depends on 70-80% pre-leasing.

Cash flow: Q1 land spend of INR574 crores and capital deployed into new Bengaluru and Mumbai pipeline; watch whether Purva Zentech proceeds (about INR625 crores EV, INR250 crores debt repayment) close in August 2026.
Q1 profitability: PAT of INR25 crores is linked to handover-driven revenue recognition; management itself cautioned against reading a single quarter as a trend.
key_quotes: Puravankara has entered FY27 with a stronger operating rhythm.
One quarter does not define an earnings trajectory, particularly in a business where revenue recognition depends on completion, handovers and project mix.
We are giving guidance as a project-wise.
So we do not have any such guidance towards saying that we are going to become 0 debt in the next 2 years or 3 years, and we think that the debt is an important part of the business.
summary.management_tone: Confident on operations and guidance, with management repeatedly reiterating FY27 presales of INR11,200 crores and debt reduction of INR700 crores. Cautious and somewhat defensive on debt, saying new opportunities may take priority over reduction and declining to give a multi-year deleveraging timeline.
